guard: the ACP agent keeps each protocol promise its docs make: a probe leaves no trace, a turn's updates and closed tool calls reach the client before the prompt answers, sign-in is offered and reported only where it applies, list and load show the right runs, and the frame mapping neither repeats nor misreports a seat's events
why: Each mutation is a plausible one-line regression in the protocol layer or the frame mapping. The smokes import src directly, so no build runs between the mutation and the suite.

mutations.name: a probe's delete writes to the hidden store
mutations.expectRed: deleting a session that never spawned hides nothing

mutations.name: frames that beat the spawn reply are dropped
mutations.find: for (const frame of held?.frames ?? []) deliver(session, frame);
mutations.expectRed: frames published before the spawn reply still reach the client

mutations.name: a turn answers with its tool calls left open
mutations.expectRed: a tool call left open is closed before the prompt answers

mutations.name: terminal sign-in offered to every client
mutations.expectRed: a client that runs no terminal is offered no sign-in

mutations.name: a sign-in failure reported as an internal error
mutations.find: throw e instanceof SignInRequired ? RequestError.authRequired(undefined, e.message) : RequestError.internalError(undefined, e.message);
mutations.expectRed: a space that needs a sign-in fails session/new with -32000

mutations.name: list compares folders without resolving symlinks
mutations.expectRed: session/list matches the folder through a symlink

mutations.name: list ignores hidden runs
mutations.expectRed: a hidden run is not listed

mutations.name: a replay is not marked as replay
mutations.find: for (const update of updates) await send(session, update, true);
mutations.replace: for (const update of updates) await send(session, update);
mutations.expectRed: session/load replays before it answers, marked as replay

mutations.name: the channel choice is not passed to the spawn
mutations.expectRed: it spawns in the session's folder with the prompt and the chosen options

mutations.name: a failed run answers as a finished turn
mutations.expectRed: a failed run fails the prompt with the seat's message

mutations.name: applications without an event plane are offered
mutations.expectRed: applications without an event plane are not offered

mutations.name: a variant carries to a model that lacks it
mutations.find: return variantsOf(offer, next).includes(selection.variant) ? next : { ...next, variant: DEFAULT_VARIANT };
mutations.expectRed: a variant does not carry to a model that lacks it

mutations.name: a frame maps again when a history read and the live tap overlap
mutations.expectRed: a frame already mapped maps to nothing

mutations.name: a failed tool call shows as completed
mutations.expectRed: the result marker ends the call as failed when it says so

mutations.name: RUN_ERROR loses the seat's message
mutations.expectRed: RUN_ERROR ends the frame's run with the seat's message
